correctness.rationale: Two exact reversal constraints prove the full-block pattern directly. For a short leading block, the padded terminal base-power block plus full-word reversal forces a palindromic short payload and padded next block; removing paired full-width ends gives the same conditions inductively. Counting independent digit orbits gives the two formulas, a geometric series gives the generating function, and matching upper and lower length estimates yield the claimed exponent. Independent direct numeral-conversion and union/find scripts passed 138 numerical and 2128 symbolic profiles. Tests alone are not infinite proofs.
